title: From the ELBO to Maximum Likelihood: Convergence of Variational Autoencoders for Nonlinear Mixed-Effects Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.32372v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Nonlinear mixed-effects (NLME) models are the central statistical models of pharmacometrics, where they support dose selection, individualized dosing and regulatory decisions in drug development. Statistically, NLME modeling is a marginalized likelihood problem. Variational autoencoders (VAEs) solve such problems with a neural network encoder that amortizes the approximation of the intractable posterior distribution, and allow the integration of AI components into NLME modeling. This paper provides the convergence analysis of the VAE-NLME algorithm. First, its version for the evidence lower bound (ELBO) is proven to converge almost surely to the set of stationary points of the ELBO, without assuming that the encoder is trained exactly. Second, the final VAE-NLME algorithm trains the encoder on the ELBO by gradient-based optimization and uses it as proposal for importance-weighted sufficient statistics. translated_title: 从ELBO到极大似然：非线性混合效应建模中变分自编码器的收敛性分析
translated_abstract: 非线性混合效应模型是药物计量学中的核心统计模型，在药物研发中为剂量选择、个体化给药以及监管决策提供支持。从统计学角度看，NLME建模是一个边缘化似然问题。变分自编码器通过神经网络编码器对难以求解的后验分布进行摊销式近似来解决此类问题，并使得AI组件能够集成到NLME建模之中。本文对VAE-NLME算法进行了收敛性分析。首先，证明了其基于证据下界（ELBO）的版本在几乎必然意义下收敛到ELBO的稳定点集合，且无需假设编码器被精确训练。其次，最终的VAE-NLME算法通过基于梯度的优化方法在ELBO上训练编码器，并将其作为重要性加权充分统计量的建议分布。该算法几乎必然收敛到……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文对用于非线性混合效应建模的VAE-NLME算法进行了收敛性分析，证明了其基于ELBO的版本无需精确训练编码器即可几乎必然收敛到ELBO的稳定点，且最终算法通过重要性加权充分统计量收敛到极大似然意义下的解。
en_tdlr: This paper provides convergence analysis of the VAE-NLME algorithm for nonlinear mixed-effects modeling, proving that its ELBO-based version converges almost surely to ELBO stationary points without requiring exact encoder training, and that the final algorithm converges almost surely via importance-weighted sufficient statistics.
